subject: Animation
title: Rick and Morty: Sci-Fi Meets Nihilism
description: A 60-second lesson on Rick and Morty: Sci-Fi Meets Nihilism.

hook.text: Rick and Morty blends complex science fiction concepts with dark humor and surprisingly deep philosophy.

buildup.text: Dan Harmon and Justin Roiland created a show about infinite universes, time travel, and family dysfunction.

discovery.text: The show attracted a devoted fanbase that analyzed every episode for hidden lore and scientific references.

twist.text: In 2023, Roiland was fired over misconduct allegations. The show continued with a new voice cast.

climax.text: Rick and Morty showed that animated comedies could explore ideas as complex as any prestige drama.

punchline.text: A cartoon about infinite universes built its own cult.

quiz.question: What set Rick and Morty apart from other adult animated comedies?
options: It combined complex science fiction concepts with dark humor and layered philosophical themes
It aired exclusively on network television
